title: rubus gyamdaensis var. glabriusculus
intro: Rubus gyamdaensis var. glabriusculus, commonly known as Himalayan raspberry, is a variant of the Rubus gyamdaensis plant species, which is a type of raspberry native to the Himalayan region. The Himalayan raspberry has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus gyamdaensis var. glabriusculus include anti-diarrheal, anti-ulcer, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its ability to modulate various cellular pathways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
